summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 255,168 Class I shares for $2,510,850 in a private placement exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, along with a routine monthly distribution declaration and an update on its continuous public offering (up to $5 billion, various share classes, monthly NAV-based pricing with potential sales loads). The board declared per-share distributions ($0.074775 gross, net of servicing fees per class) for June, July, and August 2026. The filing is a routine periodic update of a business development company's continuous offering and dividend schedule. No special-situation event is present.
